libraries.name: docx
libraries.purpose: Word (.docx) documents: paragraphs, headings, tables, sections.

libraries.name: exceljs
libraries.purpose: Excel (.xlsx) workbooks: sheets, styles, formulas such as SUM; reading and writing.

libraries.name: pdf-lib
libraries.purpose: Create and modify PDF files: pages, text, merge, split, form fields.

libraries.name: unpdf
libraries.purpose: Extract text from PDF files (a serverless build of PDF.js).

libraries.name: mathjs
libraries.purpose: Math with units, matrices, fractions and big numbers; expression evaluation without eval.

libraries.name: jszip
libraries.license_note: Dual-licensed MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later; taken under MIT.
libraries.purpose: Read and write ZIP archives (and the parts of an Office file).

libraries.name: vega
libraries.purpose: Chart rendering to SVG. In an isolate: vega.parse(spec, null, { ast: true }) and new vega.View(..., { expr: expressionInterpreter, renderer: 'none' }).

libraries.name: vega-lite
libraries.purpose: Concise chart specifications, compiled to a Vega spec.

libraries.name: vega-interpreter
libraries.purpose: Evaluates Vega expressions without eval or new Function, which the isolate forbids.

libraries.name: pptxgenjs
libraries.purpose: PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations: slides, text, tables, shapes.

libraries.name: decimal.js
libraries.purpose: Exact decimal arithmetic for areas and money.

libraries.name: forme
libraries.license_note: With @formepdf/react 0.31.0 (MIT) and react 19.2.0 (MIT) bundled into the same module.
libraries.purpose: PDF from components: Document, Page, View, Text, Table, Row, Cell, Fixed header and footer, Svg, charts. h(Component, props, ...children) builds the tree; await renderDocument(tree) returns the PDF bytes.

libraries.name: cloudflare-puppeteer
libraries.purpose: Puppeteer: HTML and CSS to PDF, screenshots, Mermaid diagrams, in a fresh headless Chromium with no network. puppeteer.launch(env.BROWSER).

typst.purpose: Typeset PDF documents from Typst markup: compile(source, { files, inputs }) returns the PDF bytes. Diagrams with the bundled Typst packages.

packages.name: cetz
packages.license_note: Shipped unmodified as Typst source the compiler interprets; the drawing layer under fletcher, timeliney and chronos.
packages.purpose: Drawing and plots; the layer the diagram packages draw with.
